verdict.rationale: Tailscale ships Tailscale SSH, which handles authentication and authorization of SSH connections across the tailnet (auditable SSH access). That gives the password-less server access the story wants, but through identity-based auth rather than by generating SSH key pairs. Users confirm SSH'ing into their machines works smoothly. Missing for 10: any evidence of SSH key-pair generation or management, details on how password-less login is configured, and independent hands-on corroboration of Tailscale SSH specifically.
